items.name: Overseer intro
items.prompt: [slowly, warmly, vast] I have given you the power of free will. [long pause] Do with it what you will.

items.name: Overseer you found your way
items.prompt: [calm, approving] You found your way. Good.

items.name: Overseer the sea gives
items.prompt: [softly] The sea gives. [pause] Remember that.

items.name: Overseer destruction
items.prompt: [a little amused] Destruction is a kind of freedom too.

items.name: Overseer ask and I will send it
items.prompt: [generous] Ask, [pause] and I will send it down.

items.name: Overseer your world
items.prompt: [slowly, proud] That is your world. [pause] All of it.

items.name: Overseer mirror open
items.prompt: [warm, slow] Before you go anywhere: look. [pause] That is you. [amused] For now.

items.name: Overseer mirror what
items.prompt: [curious] First question. [pause] What are you?

items.name: Overseer mirror look
items.prompt: [warm] Now. [pause] How do you look?

items.name: Overseer mirror name
items.prompt: [gently] And what are you called?

items.name: Overseer mirror view
items.prompt: [calm] How will you see the world? [pause] Through your own eyes, or over your shoulder?

items.name: Overseer mirror done
items.prompt: [pleased] I will remember that. [pause] Go on, then.

items.name: Overseer is person
items.prompt: [amused] A person. Classic. Nobody will suspect a thing.

items.name: Overseer is robot
items.prompt: [amused] A robot. Beep. I will assume that means hello.

items.name: Overseer is tvbot
items.prompt: [amused] A television with legs. Finally, something worth watching.

items.name: Overseer is rollbot
items.prompt: [amused] A ball with ambitions. Roll with it.

items.name: Overseer is dog
items.prompt: [warm, amused] Who is a good dog? You are. Obviously.

items.name: Overseer is cat
items.prompt: [warm, amused] A cat. You were going to ignore me anyway.

items.name: Overseer is fox
items.prompt: [warm, amused] A fox. Clever. Suspiciously clever.

items.name: Overseer is pig
items.prompt: [warm, amused] A pig. Clean, clever, and deeply misunderstood.

items.name: Overseer is bear
items.prompt: [warm, amused] A bear. Please do not eat Pip.

items.name: Overseer is rabbit
items.prompt: [warm, amused] A bunny. Hop responsibly.

items.name: Overseer is penguin
items.prompt: [warm, amused] A penguin. Dressed for a party that has not started yet.

items.name: Overseer is chicken
items.prompt: [warm, amused] A chicken. Brave of you, all things considered.

items.name: Overseer is cow
items.prompt: [warm, amused] A cow. Moo is a complete sentence.

items.name: Overseer is sheep
items.prompt: [warm, amused] A sheep. Fluffy, and following no one.

items.name: Overseer is horse
items.prompt: [warm, amused] A horse. Neigh-ver change.

items.name: Overseer is dinosaur
items.prompt: [warm, amused] A dinosaur. Extinction was only ever a rumor.

items.name: Overseer is fish
items.prompt: [warm, amused] A fish. On land. Bold. Very bold.

items.name: Overseer is shoe
items.prompt: [dry, amused] A shoe. Bold. The universe has never seen a shoe with ambition.

items.name: Overseer is toaster
items.prompt: [dry, amused] A toaster. Warm, reliable, and never allowed near the bath.

items.name: Overseer is cactus
items.prompt: [dry, amused] A cactus. Hugs are off the table, then.

items.name: Overseer is cone
items.prompt: [dry, amused] A traffic cone. You will direct traffic. Or stand there. Either way.

items.name: Overseer is teapot
items.prompt: [dry, amused] A teapot. Short and stout, I am told.

items.name: Overseer is banana
items.prompt: [dry, amused] A banana. Please, nobody slip.

items.name: Overseer is mushroom
items.prompt: [dry, amused] A mushroom. A fun guy, I hear.

items.name: Overseer is potato
items.prompt: [dry, amused] A potato. Humble. Versatile. Mashed, eventually.

items.name: Overseer is duck
items.prompt: [dry, amused] A rubber duck. Squeak with purpose.

items.name: Overseer welcome aboard
items.prompt: [warm, vast] Welcome aboard.

items.name: Overseer a new one
items.prompt: [generous] A new one, [pause] from me.
